title: Chern numbers in quantum graphs
summary: Quantum graphs provide an analytically tractable setting for the study of Chern numbers and band degeneracies in periodic systems. We study the Chern numbers of energy bands in a two-dimensional square lattice quantum graph. We approach the problem by mapping the lattice to a single-vertex quantum graph with two loops of equal lengths pierced by magnetic fluxes.
